contract.task: Compare actual 115/230V candidate ratios in the requested 120/220V modes before selecting transformer, reservoir or U4. No native adoption.
contract.line_basis: Engineering +/-10% screen around each requested nominal mains voltage, not a claimed local statutory supply tolerance or transformer operating approval.

replacement_U4.iq_basis: 8.5mA over temperature plus1mA line and0.5mA load changes; conservative arithmetic screen within specified conditions.

limits: Transformer regulation is typical, not bounded. Resistive equivalent derived from nominal loaded voltage/current; not measured DCR or an electromagnetic model.
Actual core flux, primary tolerance, mains switching and fault protection are not qualified by secondary scaling.
1000/4700uF comparison uses the minus20% capacitance corner only, with the old assumed ESR. Exact capacitor, plus-tolerance/inrush, ripple, lifetime and size need separate checks.
Existing logic/audio reserve profiles are not proven actual maximum loads.
No socket/footprint, heatsink, supplier stock or Shanghai delivery approval.

effective_model.purpose: Secondary rectifier loading and conditional thermal envelope; not a regulator stability or safety model.
effective_model.winding_basis: Illustrative 18V at 0.25A with 10/20% resistive voltage-rise approximation. Not measurements or a transformer model; primary loss, leakage and saturation omitted.

load_basis.audio: Six OPA2134 channels at 5mA maximum quiescent per amplifier at stated datasheet conditions gives30mA each rail; 20/70mA added reserve is a test assumption, not a validated maximum signal/fault budget.
load_basis.logic: 2/10/20mA scenario assumptions; not a verified current budget. Idle can violate L7805 minimum5mA regulation condition.
load_basis.relay: Cold-coil screen imported from control-switching through calculate_loads.load(); see retained budget, not the historical room-temperature assumption.

effective_model.iq_basis: L78 8mA plus1mA line/0.5mA load variation; L79 3mA plus1mA line/0.5mA load variation. Planning screens using tabulated conditions; not universal guaranteed startup/fault limits. Proposed U4 instead uses the TI LM340 over-temperature bound and variations declared in transformer-candidates.json.
effective_model.raw_screen_basis: Candidate TI U4 14.5-27V intersects unchanged ST U6 17.5-28V; negative ST U7 screen unchanged. No change to the actual native ST U4 rating.
effective_model.thermal_basis: 100C junction is engineering target;1C/W insulator/contact path and ambient are assumptions. Shared sink computation includes all four regulators; no selected heatsink or measured chassis temperature.

sources.scope: Tables2,10,15,16, minimum load and regulation ranges

limitations: No regulator control-loop/macromodel; loads are imposed on raw rails after a startup ramp.
No DC-output startup, reverse-current, protection, audio clipping or relay transient qualification.
Generic exponential diode model is an assumed rectification surrogate, not exact selected1N4007 model.
No transformer selection, mains-switch/fuse approval or Shanghai procurement qualification.
No inferred socket qualification from current or thermal results.
effective_model.thermal_electrical_corner_basis: Use minimum output bounds for device dissipation and maximum12.6V U5 input. Sum of independent worst-direction bounds is conservative; not one simultaneous output-voltage corner. Valid only while regulation holds and within stated current/temperature assumptions.

limitations: Heater cold-start surge, winding regulation, tolerances and selected tube supplier
Logic dynamic current and audio signal or fault current
Regulator short-circuit limit, protection clearing time and trace fault withstand
Copper thickness, board ambient, temperature rise, necks, vias and connector contact derating
Exact transformer, heatsink, socket implementation and China procurement/delivery
